definitionZh: 矢量效应 CSS 属性在 SVG 中抑制特定的变换效果,从而可以像地图上的道路一样保持相同的宽度,无论地图如何缩放,或者允许图键保留其位置和大小,无论其他变换如何. 它只能与接受属性的SVG元素一起使用. 使用时,CSS值会凌驾于元素的矢量效应属性的任何值.
sourceDefinition: The vector-effect CSS property suppresses specific transformation effects in SVG, thus permitting effects like a road on a map staying the same width no matter how the map is zoomed, or allowing a diagram key to retain its position and size regardless of other transforms. It can only be used with SVG elements that accept the attribute. When used, the CSS value overrides any values of the element's vector-effect attribute.
